smoke.run: uv run python tools/health_check.py "$APP_URL/api/health" "$APP_VERSION_REF" 36 && uv run python tools/surface_contract.py "$APP_URL"

preview_gate.bootstrap: cd apps/app-web && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
preview_gate.run: uv run python tools/health_check.py "$APP_URL/api/health" "$APP_VERSION_REF" 36 && bash tools/warm_surface.sh "$APP_URL" / /research/rankings && (cd apps/app-web && TA_BASE_URL="$APP_URL" node e2e/walk-tree.mjs) && uv run python tools/surface_contract.py --authenticated "$APP_URL"

staging_gate.bootstrap: cd apps/app-web && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
staging_gate.run: uv run python tools/health_check.py "$APP_URL/api/health" "$APP_VERSION_REF" 36 && bash tools/warm_surface.sh "$APP_URL" / /research/rankings && (cd apps/app-web && TA_BASE_URL="$APP_URL" node e2e/walk-tree.mjs) && uv run python tools/surface_contract.py --authenticated "$APP_URL"

scheduled_audit.run: uv run python tools/nightly_verdicts.py "$APP_URL/api/health" --environment "$ENVIRONMENT" --repo . && uv run python tools/surface_contract.py "$APP_URL"
